jobs.title: Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.descriptionText:
We're hiring a software engineer to build and maintain our hiring platform.

What you'll do:
- Build ASP.NET Core Web APIs in C# backed by MongoDB.
- Turn design specs into responsive pages with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
- Write unit tests and take features from design to production in an agile team.

Nice to have: some Python, and experience shipping services with Docker.

jobs.title: NLP Engineer (Python)
jobs.descriptionText:
Join the team that turns unstructured resumes into structured data.

What you'll do:
- Build entity extraction pipelines in Python with spaCy.
- Serve models behind FastAPI services packaged with Docker.
- Measure extraction quality and improve it with better rules and training data.

Nice to have: machine learning experience with PyTorch, and AWS.
